test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sentences uses the word "tire" with the **same meaning** as in the following sentence? "I am starting to tire of this long journey"

options.text: My bicycle has a flat tire.
The mechanic replaced the old tire.
The baby started to tire of playing with the same toy.
We needed to put air in the car’s tire.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The baby started to tire of playing with the same toy .
